title: Dune Allen "Dancing in the Sand" 15 Fort Panic Road
h1: Dune Allen "Dancing in the Sand" 15 Fort Panic Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Partially gulf front with amazing gulf views- Private access to the public beach- 6 Seater Low-Speed Vehicle- Private pool **Pool heating is available for this property from Oct 1 through May 1 for $60 per day**- 6 adult bikes- Stand Alone Ice Maker- Fire pit- Spacious Walk-in Pantry- Grill- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Escape for an enchanting Gulf-front getaway at Dancing in the Sand, an incredible 6-bedroom, 4-bathroom Dune Allen home that sleeps 16. Fall in love with the sprawling Gulf views, inviting private pool, and quick beach access—straight off the back deck!The first floor of this 4-level home features a charming bunk room with an XL twin-over-XL twin bunk bed and queen bed.On the second level, a wall of oversized windows welcomes guests to the open living and dining spaces, drawing eyes to the breathtaking views of the beach and pool. Hardwood floors, a palette of soothing gray, shell white, and midnight blue, complement the ever-changing colors of the Gulf. Enjoy evenings relaxing on the comfortable wraparound sofa and 2 armchairs facing the 65” Smart TV, or gathering for games at the 10-seat dining table. The adjacent kitchen has a raised bar that seats 2, marble countertops, and premium appliances—including a 6-burner gas range, stand-alone ice maker, and wine cooler. Glass doors open from either side of the living area onto the enormous pool deck, inviting guests to unwind on the chaise lounges or take a swim. Savor an alfresco meal, cooked on the gas grill, at the outdoor table for 6, followed by cocktails around the firepit. Steps lead down from the deck to the public beach below for easy access. At bedtime, retire to the guest bedroom down the hall with a queen bed and Gulf views.A primary bedroom boasting a king bed, captivating Gulf views, a 55” Smart TV, and a cozy seating area offers a restful space on the third level. Additionally, there are 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and TVs—1 shares access to the Gulf-facing balcony with the primary bedroom.On the fourth floor, a delightful bunk room gives youthful guests their own hangout, complete with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, a sitting area, a 60” TV, and a partially covered deck overlooking the gorgeous Gulf. Relax on the outdoor sofa and chat the night away after toasting the blazing sunset.Dancing in the Sand is a fantastic home base for a Dune Allen beach vacation. Easily explore 30A with parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway and 1 vehicle in the garage, a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, and 6 included adult bikes. Book today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and XL twin-over-XL twin bunk bedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower OnlyFOURTH FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds*While the home technically is gulf-front, please note that another smaller home sits in front of it and some views may be obstructed.*
